rule: Generate humanoid source motion only. Do not directly retarget humanoid joint rotations to the EvoWild S quadruped.

cases.prompt: A person sprints forward at a steady fast pace.
A person accelerates from a run into a full sprint.
A person decelerates smoothly from a sprint to a run.

cases.intent: follow a curved root path or waypoints while running
cases.prompt: A person runs quickly along a curved path.
A person runs forward and makes a fast controlled direction change.
